interpreted_intent: Requester asks for independent randomized complex photographic horror qualification using the supplied image. Horror is the topic context supplied by the coordinator, not a new user definition. Arm A independently chooses an everyday salvage task in a leaking self-storage office: the woman has lifted vulnerable family photographs toward an exit whose shutter is closing, then notices that her mirror image performs a different bodily action and holds an undamaged closed carton. The viewer first recognizes the careful practical grip and vulnerable material, then sees the mirrored palm pressing the glass and reinterprets the interrupted task as a threat. These setting, motive, gesture, carton states and reflection mechanic are agent-owned staging. Face and hair reference appearance remains assessable, with subtle attraction carried by luminous eyes and soft lips rather than changing her features. Saved sensual=1, fetish=0, creativity=1 and surreal=0 are retained; the single anomalous reflection realizes the assigned horror-family experiment and no additional unrelated surreal treatment is introduced.
subject: A fictional adult woman using visible face and hair appearance from the supplied portrait, plus her own mirror image.
setting: A leaking upper-floor self-storage office with a half-lowered roller shutter and a stored leaning framed mirror.
event: A practical task is interrupted by an unnerving discovery while the woman holds a damp carton of photographs.
visual_priorities: The real woman supports the soaked open carton with both hands, connecting her interrupted task to photographs vulnerable to the leak.
The mirror contains her recognizable face but an independently placed right palm against the glass and a dry closed carton in the reflected left arm.
The glass frame, coherent reflected room lines and condensation patch localize the anomaly to a material mirror.
The narrowing shutter exit and wet-floor stream make the timing and cost of her hesitation visible.
baseline_prompt_en: An everyday uncanny horror photograph of a woman guided by the supplied portrait, caught in an unnerving interruption of a practical task. The subject is a fictional adult woman; her facial appearance and hair follow the attached portrait: a chin-length dark brown bob with wispy parted bangs, large dark brown eyes, softly rounded cheeks, a short straight nose and naturally glossy rose lips. She is inside an upper-floor self-storage office during a rainstorm, trying to rescue a carton of household photographs before a half-lowered metal roller shutter shuts the exit. A ceiling leak has soaked one corner of the carton and left a narrow glistening stream across the concrete floor; a rubber wedge lies just inside the shutter gap. She supports the soaked open cardboard carton at waist height with both hands beneath its base, elbows bent close to her ribs. Her feet are planted on the dry strip beside the water. A transparent sleeve of small household photographs protrudes between the spread flaps, and she has turned her face toward a tall framed mirror leaning against the wall immediately beside her. Her lips have just parted and her shoulders hold the arrested weight of the box. Inside the mirror, the same face and bob are clearly recognizable, but her reflected right palm is pressed flat against the inner glass with five separated fingers, while her reflected left arm cradles a dry, neatly closed version of the carton. The real woman's two hands remain plainly visible beneath the open box. The mirrored palm and changed carton belong to her reflected body; the continuous metal frame makes the glass boundary unmistakable. A clean palm-shaped patch interrupts light condensation on that glass. The ordinary room lines, shutter and lamp still align across the reflection. A cool overhead LED shapes her eyes, cheek and fingertips, while amber corridor light enters under the shutter and grazes the wet floor. She wears a soft navy knit shirt beneath a practical faded canvas jacket. Frame her real face, supported carton, reflected face and palm as the connected center of attention, with the threatened exit behind them. An eye-level three-quarter camera view, a natural 50mm perspective, a medium view from head to mid-thigh and enough depth of field to read both faces keep this intimate discovery assessable. Real skin texture, softened shirt creases, saturated cardboard fibers, transparent sleeve edges and restrained low-light grain make the impossible reflection sit inside a materially credible photograph.
